t: This is the statue of Robert Milligan, made by Richard Westmacott and first set up at the West India Docks in 1813. Milligan was a merchant and the driving force behind building those docks. He was also a ship-owner and slave trader, and by his death in 1809 one of his partnerships had interests in Jamaican estates that held 526 enslaved people. The statue was put in storage in 1943 and re-erected here by the London Docklands Development Corporation in 1997.
